name: ADX-gated breakout continuation — Donchian ceiling break only in a trend (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: raw breakout entries bleed on fees in choppy regimes because most breaks fail; the economic edge is CONDITIONAL — breakouts pay only when a directional regime already exists. ADX separates trend from chop, so entering when range_position is near the ceiling (a Donchian-style break) ONLY when adx is high harvests the minority of breaks that continue while skipping the fee-churning majority. The counterparty is breakout-faders and mean-reversion grid bots who are right most of the time but pay in the tail. The 4h bar keeps trade count (and fee drag) low — fewer, higher-conviction trades. DISCONFIRMER: kill if the adx gate gives no incremental net lift over the ungated breakout — run the identical spec with the adx condition removed; if CSCV-PBO / DSR is not materially worse without it, the gate is a free parameter the optimizer tuned, not a regime signal, and the strategy dies.
catalyst: range-ceiling breakout inside a confirmed trend
